name: Codex CLI

requirements.hint: Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs; rustup picks up the toolchain each release pins
Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs

typecheck: cd codex-rs && cargo check -p codex-cli --bin codex
build: cd codex-rs && sed -i.openmods.bak '1,/^version = "/s/^version = "[^"]*"/version = "'"${OPENMODS_VERSION}+${OPENMODS_MODS}"'"/' Cargo.toml && rm -f Cargo.toml.openmods.bak && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 cargo build --release -p codex-cli --bin codex
